rationale: S1 main generation, scaled up from the 16/system trial. System list (7 light + 3 light-heavy B-As/B-As-P/B-Sb for the BAs-like a-o-gap route, Feng/Lindsay/Ruan PRB 96 161201) and sizes (256 light, 512 light-heavy) proposed by Claude, approved by the user in chat 11-09. Arm 'cseh': chemical_system_energy_above_hull checkpoint, E_hull target 0.05 eV/atom (README example); compared with arm 'cs' on yield per GPU-h (DESIGN §4.1).
